select * from (
SELECT channel.*,string_agg(ssubscribeNumUserAccess.user_id::text, ',') as subscribeUserIds,
CASE WHEN ( SELECT count(1) FROM gc_user_access_permission per LEFT JOIN gc_user_access acc ON acc.id = per.user_access_id WHERE per.subscribe_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) and acc.user_id = #{userId} and acc.master_id=#{masterId} GROUP BY acc.user_id ) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS followFlag
info.last_name AS createUserLastName, info.first_name AS createUserFirstName, tags.id AS tag_id, tags.channel_id AS tag_channel_id, tags.type AS tag_type, tags.tag_text AS tag_text, string_agg(tags.tag_text, ',') AS channelTags FROM pt_channel channel LEFT JOIN pt_channel_subscribe sub on channel.id = sub.channel_id left join gc_user us on us.id = channel.create_user_id left join gc_user_info info on info.id = us.info_id left join pt_tags tags on tags.channel_id = channel.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_access_permission permission ON permission.subscribe_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) LEFT JOIN gc_user_access userAccess on userAccess.id = permission.user_access_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_access_permission accessPermission ON accessPermission.channel_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) LEFT JOIN gc_user_access access on access.id = accessPermission.user_access_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_access_permission subscribeNumPermission ON subscribeNumPermission.subscribe_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) LEFT JOIN gc_user_access ssubscribeNumUserAccess on ssubscribeNumUserAccess.id = subscribeNumPermission.user_access_id WHERE 1 = 1 and level=0
and userAccess.user_id = #{userId} and userAccess.master_id =#{masterId} and permission.subscribe_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) or ( channel.create_user_id =#{userId} and channel.level=0 and channel.master_id = #{masterId})
and access.user_id = #{userId} and access.master_id=#{masterId} and (accessPermission.subscribe_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) = false or accessPermission.subscribe_permission is null) and accessPermission.channel_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) and ( channel.create_user_id !=#{userId} and channel.level=0 ) and channel.master_id = #{masterId}
GROUP BY channel.id order by channel.create_time desc
) as channels where channels.followFlag=0 order by channels.create_time desc

SELECT channel.*, COALESCE((select count(ua.id) from gc_access access LEFT JOIN gc_user_access ua on ua.access_id=access.id where access.subscribe_json::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) ),0) as subscribeNum,info.last_name as createUserLastName, info.first_name as createUserFirstName,tags.id as tag_id,tags.channel_id as tag_channel_id,tags.type as tag_type,tags.tag_text as tag_text, string_agg(tags.tag_text, ',') as channelTags FROM pt_channel channel left join gc_user us on us.id = channel.create_user_id left join gc_user_info info on info.id = us.info_id left join pt_tags tags on tags.channel_id = channel.id left join gc_user_access_permission permission on permission.channel_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) left join gc_user_access ua on ua.id = permission.user_access_id left join gc_access access on access.id = ua.access_id where access.id=#{accessId} and ua.master_id=#{masterId} group by channel.id

select ch.*, u.username as channel_create_user_username,u.id as channel_create_uid,info.last_name as createUserLastName, info.first_name as createUserFirstName,tags.id as tag_id,tags.channel_id as tag_channel_id,tags.type as tag_type,tags.tag_text as tag_text, string_agg(tags.tag_text, ',') as channelTags, info.avatar_file_id as userInfo_avatar_file_id from pt_channel ch left join gc_user u on u.id = ch.create_user_id left join gc_user_info info on info.id = u.info_id left join sys_file file on file.id = info.avatar_file_id left join pt_tags tags on tags.channel_id = ch.id
where 1=1 and ch.id in
#{channelId}
where 1=2
and ch.channel_name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
group by ch.id

info.last_name AS createUserLastName, info.first_name AS createUserFirstName, tags.id AS tag_id, tags.channel_id AS tag_channel_id, tags.type AS tag_type, tags.tag_text AS tag_text, string_agg(tags.tag_text, ',') AS channelTags FROM pt_channel channel LEFT JOIN pt_channel_subscribe sub on channel.id = sub.channel_id left join gc_user us on us.id = channel.create_user_id left join gc_user_info info on info.id = us.info_id left join pt_tags tags on tags.channel_id = channel.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_access_permission permission ON permission.subscribe_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) LEFT JOIN gc_user_access userAccess on userAccess.id = permission.user_access_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_access_permission accessPermission ON accessPermission.channel_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) LEFT JOIN gc_user_access access on access.id = accessPermission.user_access_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_access_permission subscribeNumPermission ON subscribeNumPermission.subscribe_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) LEFT JOIN gc_user_access ssubscribeNumUserAccess on ssubscribeNumUserAccess.id = subscribeNumPermission.user_access_id WHERE((accessPermission.id is not null) or (subscribeNumPermission.id is not null)) and (userAccess.user_id = #{userId} or access.user_id = #{userId}) and level=0

and access.user_id = #{userId} and access.master_id=#{masterId} and (accessPermission.subscribe_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) = false or accessPermission.subscribe_permission is null ) and accessPermission.channel_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) and ( channel.create_user_id !=#{userId} and channel.level=0 ) and channel.master_id = #{masterId}
GROUP BY channel.id order by channel.create_time desc
) as channels where channels.followFlag=0 order by channels.create_time desc

and concat(chs.channel_name,chs.channel_slug) like concat('%',#{searchName},'%')

select channel.channel_img_file_id,channel."desc",channel.create_user_id,channel.visible_flag,channel.category_id, channel.level,channel.fid,channel."order",channel.master_id,coalesce(channel.channel_slug,ch2.channel_slug) as channel_slug,channel.create_time, channel.update_time,channel.channel_avatar_file_id, coalesce(ch2.id,channel.id) as id, coalesce(ch2.channel_name,channel.channel_name) as channel_name, file.id as fileId, info.last_name AS createUserLastName, info.first_name AS createUserFirstName, info.avatar_file_id as userInfo_avatar_file_id, us2.id as channel_create_uid, count(vac.id) as likeNum, case when vac.user_id=#{userId} then 1 else 0 end as likedFlag, pcc.id as channelContentId from sys_file file left join pt_channel_content pcc on file.id = pcc.file_id left join pt_channel channel on pcc.channel_id = channel.id left join pt_channel ch2 on ch2.id = channel.fid left join gc_user_access_permission permission ON (permission.subscribe_permission::jsonb || permission.channel_permission::jsonb) @> to_jsonb(coalesce(ch2.id,channel.id)::integer) left join gc_user_access userAccess ON userAccess.id = permission.user_access_id left join gc_user us on us.id = userAccess.user_id left join gc_user us2 on us2.id = channel.create_user_id left join gc_user_info info on info.id = us2.info_id left join gc_user_video_action vac on vac.file_id = file.id and vac."type" = 1 where 1=1 and (userAccess.user_id = #{userId} and us.id = #{userId} and userAccess.master_id = #{masterId} OR ( channel.create_user_id =#{userId} AND channel.master_id = #{masterId} ) and pcc.id is not null)
and file."name" like concat('%',#{searchName},'%')
GROUP BY file.id order by file.update_time desc

select file.file_url channel_video_file_url, file.save_type as channel_video_save_type, file.file_type_index as channel_video_type_index, file.thumb_nail_id as channel_thumb_nail_id, file.thumb_nail_url as channel_thumb_nail_url ,file.id as video_file_id, channel.*, us.username as channel_create_user_username,us.id as channel_create_uid,info.last_name as createUserLastName, info.first_name as createUserFirstName, info.avatar_file_id as userInfo_avatar_file_id from pt_channel channel left join pt_channel_content pcc on channel.id = pcc.channel_id left join gc_user_access_permission permission ON (permission.subscribe_permission::jsonb || permission.channel_permission::jsonb) @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) left join gc_user_access ac on ac.id = permission.user_access_id left join gc_user us on ac.user_id = us.id left join gc_user_info info on info.id = us.info_id left join sys_file file on file.id = pcc.file_id where 1=1 and ac.user_id = #{userId} and ac.master_id = #{masterId} and file.id is not null group by file.id order by file.update_time desc

select f.*,count( vac.id ) AS likeNum , case when vac.user_id=#{userId} then 1 else 0 end as likedFlag from (select channel.channel_img_file_id,channel."desc",channel.create_user_id,channel.visible_flag,channel.category_id, channel.level,channel.fid,channel."order",channel.master_id,coalesce(channel.channel_slug,ch2.channel_slug) as channel_slug,channel.create_time, channel.update_time, file.update_time as file_update_time, coalesce(ch2.channel_avatar_file_id,channel.channel_avatar_file_id) as channel_avatar_file_id, coalesce(ch2.id,channel.id) as id, coalesce(ch2.channel_name,channel.channel_name) as channel_name, file.id as fileId, info.last_name AS userInfo_lastName, info.first_name AS userInfo_firstName, info.avatar_file_id as userInfo_avatar_file_id, us2.id as channel_create_uid, us2.username as channel_create_user_username, pcc.id as channelContentId from sys_file file left join pt_channel_content pcc on file.id = pcc.file_id left join pt_channel channel on pcc.channel_id = channel.id left join pt_channel ch2 on ch2.id = channel.fid left join gc_user_access_permission permission ON (permission.subscribe_permission::jsonb || permission.channel_permission::jsonb) @> to_jsonb(coalesce(ch2.id,channel.id)::integer) left join gc_user_access userAccess ON userAccess.id = permission.user_access_id left join gc_user us on us.id = userAccess.user_id left join gc_user us2 on us2.id = channel.create_user_id left join gc_user_info info on info.id = us2.info_id where 1=1 and userAccess.user_id = #{userId} and us.id = #{userId} and userAccess.master_id = #{masterId} and pcc.id is not null or((channel.create_user_id = #{userId} or ch2.create_user_id = #{userId}) and channel.master_id = #{masterId}) and channel.master_id = #{masterId} GROUP BY file.id order by file.update_time desc ) as f left join gc_user_video_action vac on f.fileId = vac.file_id and vac."type" = 1 GROUP BY f.fileId order by f.file_update_time desc
